title.narrative: Promoting a more Equitable, Sustainable and Safer Education

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective is to improve the Ministry of Education's planning functions and support access to primary education with improved learning conditions

The development objective of the Promoting an Efficient Education System in Haiti is to improve the ministry of education's planning and regulatory functions and the learning assessment system. The project comprises of three components. The first component, improving planning and regulation aims at strengthening the management of the education sector. It consists of following sub-components: (i) strengthening planning capacity; (ii) strengthening departmental directorate of education (DDEs) planning capacity; and (iii) supporting regulatory capacity. The second component, improving the learning assessment system will aim at strengthening the management of the education sector by supporting the improvement of the learning assessment system at the centralized level and the decentralized level. It consists of following sub-components: (i) improving the learning assessment system at the central level; and (ii) improving the learning assessment system at the decentralized level. The third component, project management, monitoring and evaluation will provide support to ministry of national education and vocational training (MENFP) for project implementation, monitoring, and evaluation.

title.narrative: PDOI4 Students enrolled in schools benefitting from classrooms built or rehabilitated according to international standards and from an improved learning environment

comment.narrative: The year-2 target for this indicator is not met. With the current crisis, the processes for the full rehabilitation of 5 public schools have been delayed. Meanwhile, the Project has supported the repairs of 26 classrooms, construction of 45 semi-permanent classrooms, and repairs and reconstruction of 9 toilet blocks, 4 administrative rooms and 3 storage rooms in 13 public schools damaged/destroyed by the August 2021 earthquake. These works are not exactly the types of works defined for this indicator and were not expected at the time of Project design; they had been planned under the previous PEQH project which was hindered by the crisis of September-December 2022. The planned Project restructuring will bring necessary revisions to the RF to account for these substantial works.

title.narrative: PDOI1. Gender. The EMIS is used to improve planning and decision-making

baseline.value: Data collection strategy to be updated

target.value: EMIS data is used for decision-making (allocation of at least two of resources is informed by data from the EMIS, including one based on sex disaggregated data).

comment.narrative:
The year-2 target for this PDOI is met. However, in the current unprecedented country context, the steps of data collection, management, sharing, and analysis are encountering important delays. Furthermore, recent discussions with MENFP indicated that – for impact - a most important result of the EMIS activity may not only be the publication of a report or yearbook of statistics (as specified in the current year-3 target), but would also be the timely use of the new databases in the different functions and programs of the system (even before the publication of statistics). The upcoming Project restructuring plans to account for these realities and discussions and adjust the targets accordingly.
Regarding the Gender sub-indicator, collected data will be analyzed to identify areas where the gender gap in schooling is the highest. In light of the aforementioned delays, the Project restructuring i also expected to adjust the end target for this sub-indicator.

actual.value: Newly collected school-level data stored in the EMIS is ready for analysis. Data collection at the student and teacher levels is being finalized.

title.narrative: IRI5. Strategy for learning assessments is developed, implemented and used for decision-making

baseline.value: Learning assessment system diagnostic has been prepared and is pending validation

target.value: Results are used for decision-making (allocation of at least one set of resources is informed by learning assessment data)

comment.narrative: The year-2 target for this IRI is met. The scope of the framework document has gone beyond the primary level (which was in the original design of the GPE financing) and covers pre-school, primary and secondary levels, given important linkages among them as confirmed with the MENFP. The framework is also formulated to reflect pragmatic MENFP priorities including the use of existing assessment data and strengthening of national exams, and not just the implementation of new learning assessments as indicated in the existing year-3 and year-4 targets of the IRI. The planned Project restructuring will bring relevant changes to the IRI and its targets in view of these issues.

actual.value: The framework document on learning assessments has been reviewed by MENFP to inform the preparation of a learning assessment plan.
